title: Finalize the canonical restart checkpoint after the Stage D pilot
purpose: Replace the obsolete pre-Stage-D restart checkpoint with a concise repository-first checkpoint bound to the accepted Stage B, Stage C and controlled Stage D pilot results. The checkpoint must identify exact commits, current risks, held domains and the next design-only gate so a future agent does not repeat completed work or start stable-identifier implementation prematurely.
invariants: The checkpoint reflects exact repository state at base commit eb296c14825d1a624c96806ee3eba073e6225b69.
Stage B, Stage C and the controlled Stage D pilot are recorded as accepted with their exact evidence roots.
The promoted product baseline remains RC718 with RC719 PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS.
The Stage D pilot is not represented as a product RC and did not change the tested artifact.
The next gate is design-only stable identity and migration planning; implementation remains held.
The Player working-file count of 150 and the unenforced private-repository ruleset remain explicit risks.
Backend, accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain held.
Old handovers are explicitly subordinate to current main, governor state, accepted work packages and exact evidence.
No runtime, workflow, architecture, roadmap, evidence or governor-state content changes.
requiredEvidence: accepted ARC-WP-014 exact first-seam result and governor review
accepted ARC-WP-019 exact Stage D pilot result and governor review
promoted RC718 baseline and RC719 human attestation
Repository governance and PR scope green on this documentation-only pull request
adversarialTests: fail if the checkpoint claims a new product RC
fail if exact tested, merge or acceptance commits are omitted or mismatched
fail if stable-identifier implementation is described as authorized
fail if any held platform domain is described as open
fail if the Player file-budget or ruleset exception is hidden
fail if an old handover is given precedence over repository state
fail if any file outside the three exact allowed paths changes
independentReview: Repository governance validates the work package
PR scope validates the exact three-file documentation scope
The governor verifies all commit and evidence references against main
rollback: Revert the documentation-only merge. No source, artifact, learner data, governance state or external system is affected.
